module: Sketch of a vehicle metadata editor for the selector. The module is almost empty: its only function returns fixed values. Its reference in the dependencies of ui_vehicleSelector_general is commented out.
notes: getVehicleMetadataDetails ignores its data parameter and always returns {name = 'Default Vehicle Name', description = 'Default vehicle description', type = 'Car'}: it is a placeholder.

getVehicleMetadataDetails.desc: Returns dummy vehicle metadata (name, description, type), whatever the argument.

returns.desc: {name, description, type} with fixed default values.
